beltsnpieces.hud.confirm_height: Choose height, then right-click to place; left-click to cancel
beltsnpieces.config.beltQuality.tooltip: How detailed the curves for reinforced belts are
beltsnpieces.config.maximumBeltLength.to: How long a reinforced belt can be, roughly following the lengths of regular belts
How many times a reinforced belt can be adjusted with the wrench before blocking new adjustments
beltsnpieces.config.chainConveyorCutoffA: How steep a chain conveyor can get before it cuts off and you can't place it
beltsnpieces.ponder.reinforced_belt_plac: Reinforced Belts carry items around curves and between heights.
Right-click a horizontal shaft to begin.
Aim to choose the other end. Bring a shaft for a new endpoint.
Sneak-scroll to choose a curve style.
Right-click to lock the horizontal position.
Look up or down to set the height shown by the box.
Right-click again to place the belt.
The crosshair shows how many belts and shafts you need.
Keep the route clear and within the length limit.
beltsnpieces.ponder.reinforced_belt_adju: Use a wrench to reshape a placed belt. Endpoints stay fixed.
Hold right-click with a wrench. Look up or down to change height.
Keep holding and scroll to move the section horizontally.
Release to apply. Left-click to reset the adjustment.
Power either endpoint to drive the belt.
Leave room for the whole curve.
beltsnpieces.ponder.reinforced_belt_tran: Items follow the curve, even uphill.
Right-click with dye to colour the whole belt.
Apply casing to cover the belt. Wrench its side or underside to remove it.
Sneak-right-click an endpoint with a wrench to dismantle and recover the belts.
beltsnpieces.ponder.belt_void_passage.te: Place a Belt Void on a section of a moving Create belt.
Items pass through while the output is clear.
When the output backs up to this section, the Belt Void destroys the excess items.
Voided items are gone for good.
Clear the output and items pass through again.
